package orders

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/app/orders"
)

func TestPlaceOrder(t *testing.T) {
	o := orders.NewPlaceOrder()
	if err := o.Run(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Run: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestCancelOrder(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name string
	}{
		{name: "happy"},
		{name: "already-cancelled"},
		{name: "not-found"},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_ = orders.CancelOrder(tc.name)
		})
	}
}

func TestOrderCreatedEvent(t *testing.T) {
	// Contract test for the "order.created" topic.
	_ = "order.created"
}

	// Not a test — should not be picked up.
}
